tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
eMemory's subsidiary has secured a security trust position, with its security intellectual property entering Meta and Arm data center processors. Confirmed by UDN.
Delhi High Court has directed removal of artificial intelligence deepfakes and fabricated content involving Kangana Ranaut. Confirmed by The Times of India.
Resilinc's Copilot plugin delivers real-time supply chain risk intelligence to procurement teams. Reported by EME Outlook Magazine.
California has banned employers from using artificial intelligence alone to fire workers, requiring human review and transparency. Reported by Law Commentary.
Microsoft's president warns that artificial intelligence is less regulated than milk. Reported by The Guardian.
Free every hour.
